'''Amatha Fetz''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. She worked her way from the lower classes through hard work, a head for business, and a little [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]]. Fetz was eventually accepted by the [[Liann]] upper class by owning her own shipping firm, [[Tion Hauling]].
